verdict.rationale: Riskified returns model-driven per-order recommendations through its API: CVV/3DS step-up and TRA/SCA exemption suggestions, and approve/review/decline recommendations on claims, with models calibrated by its analytics team. These are transactional fraud decisions rather than AI-generated insights about the merchant's data surfaced inside the product, and the docs never describe them as AI-generated. Missing for 10: in-product AI insights or dashboard, natural-language or copilot-style suggestions, explicit AI/ML framing of the recommendations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
